venue.precondition: the symbol is one the venue published rules for (checked by the session guard only)
the quantity, and the limit price, reference price and balance when given, are finite numbers
the side is buy or sell, ignoring case — the venue's own enum
the instrument's published status is online, ignoring case
fewer submissions than the cap sit strictly inside the window ending now; a stamp exactly one window old has left it. Skipped when no window is supplied
venue.effect: none here; one slot is spent, at now, only if the whole order is allowed and the call enforces rather than self-checks

venue.precondition: a limit price, when given, is above zero. Skipped for a market order
the limit price stepped down to the tick is still above zero
venue.effect: the limit price becomes the largest tick multiple not above it

venue.precondition: with a reference price above zero, the stepped limit price lies in reference x (1 - ratio) to reference x (1 + ratio) inclusive, with the buy ratio for a buy and the sell ratio for a sell. Skipped without a limit price or a positive reference

venue.effect: the quantity becomes the step multiple nearest zero on its own side

venue.precondition: when the quantity exceeds the venue maximum, the maximum stepped down is above zero
venue.effect: a quantity above the maximum becomes the maximum stepped down

venue.precondition: the stepped quantity is at least the venue minimum; the guard may not raise it
valued at the stepped limit price, or at the reference price for a market order, the notional is at least the venue minimum. Skipped when no positive value exists
the same notional does not exceed the available balance. Skipped without a balance or without a value

venue_goals: an allowed order is never larger than the order asked for
an allowed quantity is a multiple of the step, within the venue minimum and maximum
an allowed limit price is above zero, a multiple of the tick and not above the price asked
an allowed limit price sits inside the band whenever a positive reference was given
an allowed, valued order meets the minimum notional and fits the balance when one was given
a refused order carries quantity zero and spends no rate-window slot

circuit.precondition: drawdown since the session opened is below 0.04
the signed move is above -3 sigma
the evidence is no older than 6:00:00
drawdown is below 0.02 or already at the halt

sizing.effect: otherwise size at the fixed fraction
otherwise size at the fixed fraction
a negative Kelly stake is zero, never a reversal
the Kelly stake is scaled by 0.5

sizing.precondition: both multipliers are non-negative and the session throttle is at most one

modes.precondition: every layer is present once, in the order operator, venue, circuit, posture, and the posture layer demands a mode
modes.effect: the effective mode is the most restrictive demanded (normal < paper < reduce_only < halted); the binding layer is the first, in that order, to demand it

modes.precondition: the verdict carries a quantity (trade, hedge, reduce); a reduction is admitted in every mode and on either venue; otherwise the venue is paper unless the mode is normal; reduce_only refuses trade; halted refuses trade and hedge
modes.effect: a refused trade or hedge is narrowed to reduce if positions are open, else no_trade

chain.precondition: a risk record exists for the decision
chain.effect: the approved quantity is no larger than the proposed one

chain.precondition: the protocol receives the Constitution's approved intent
chain.effect: the protocol may shrink or refuse; it never enlarges

chain.precondition: an order reaches the venue gate only if a positive quantity was approved, and never more than was approved
chain.effect: the venue gate may shrink or refuse; it never enlarges

chain.precondition: the ledger records exactly what the last gate let through, and a trade only with a positive quantity the venue gate allowed

recorded.window: replayed against an empty rate window; the live window was not recorded

counterfactual.sizes: notionals ['4.99', '5', '5.01', '100', '1000', '10000', '1000000'] USDT at the recorded price, plus each instrument's minimum and twice its maximum
counterfactual.what: synthetic sizes on real symbols, real sides and real recorded prices

notional a hair under the floor
notional a hair over the balance
limit a hair above the band, stepped back onto the tick
limit on the tick, band edge from a 31-digit reference
limit exactly on the band edge
unknown symbol through the session guard
